# Municipal Ordinance No. 02, Series of 2009

**Kautusang Bayan Blg. 02**

## Summary

Municipal Ordinance No. 02 (Kapasiyahang Laang-Gugulin Blg. 02), Series of [[2009]], enacted by the [[Sangguniang Bayan]] of [[Municipality of Pitogo|Pitogo]], Quezon on September 8, 2009. This is a supplemental appropriation ordinance authorizing the use of Three Million Eight Hundred Thirty-Five Thousand Four Hundred Fifteen Pesos and Three Centavos (P3,835,415.03) from additional realized income (Internal Revenue Allotment) as supplemental funds for the 2009 Annual Budget of the municipal government of Pitogo, Quezon.

## Key Provisions

- **Section 1** — The additional realized income from Internal Revenue Allotment, amounting to Five Million Pesos on top of the original budget of Thirty-Four Million Pesos (total: P3,835,415.03 mula sa Internal Revenue Allotment), is recognized as income for the municipality of Pitogo, Quezon.
- **Section 2** — The Supplemental Appropriation Ordinance (Karagdagang Laang-Gugulin Blg. 02, Series of 2009) for local government of Pitogo, Quezon is hereby ratified as an act of the [[Sangguniang Bayan]].
- **Section 3** — The additional Internal Revenue Allotment shall be used as supplemental budget allocation for the 2009 Annual Budget of the municipality.
- **Section 4** — This ordinance shall take effect on September 8, 2009, upon approval by the [[Sangguniang Bayan]].

## Entities

- [[Sangguniang Bayan]] — enacted the ordinance
- [[Dante U. Buñac, Sr.]] — Municipal Mayor, approved the ordinance
- [[Rodante V. Cortes]] — Vice Mayor / Presiding Officer (Tagapangulo)
- [[Diana J. Parcarey]] — Secretary to the Sangguniang Bayan
- [[Nichel F. Buñac]] — Kagawad, Pangulo - PPSK
- [[Rey C. Buñac]] — Kagawad, Pangulo - ABC
